g.text: The Conversational Map Agent — one loop core, two policies
Read-only tools · resolve, don't guess · every number carries its provenance
The model CHOOSES the place; the resolver
PRODUCES the geometry — or returns it
unresolved. Never coordinates from the model.
seed — corpus search · empty → retrieval fallback
tool round-trip · token + step budget · READ-ONLY invariant · trace
a second policy over the same core — the document path stays byte-identical (defaults); its tests are the gate
Agent, not pipeline — the control-flow graph is drawn at RUNTIME by the model (resolve → area → map, or ask to disambiguate, or decline),
not authored ahead like the ETL DAG. Autonomy is clamped hard (read-only · typed · budgeted): the deploy tax on an agent, not proof it isn't one.
